title: Yellow Buttery Malaysian Peas Biryani
description: A buttery and crumbly Malaysian dish featuring frozen peas, this biryani is a cozy and ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly meal option, made with love and care to provide a delicious and satisfying experience.
instructions: Heat ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to brown.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the turmeric powder and salt, and stir well to combine.
Add the basmati rice and stir to coat the rice with the spice mixture.
Add 4 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Fluff the cooked rice with a fork and stir in the frozen peas.
Add the butter to the rice mixture and stir until it is fully incorporated and the rice is coated in a buttery sauce.
Serve the biryani hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
